title: Trajectory, Holonomy and Return Topology — History-Dependent State Model
status: project mathematical synthesis using established geometry/topology; not evidence for new fundamental physics
provenance: Recovered from prior project waves on trajectory, topology, spin, gauge theory, Return-not-Reset, loops, braids and closed paths. The mathematical ingredients are established; their organization around project questions is a later synthesis.
abstract: A recurring project claim is that returning to the same apparent place does not imply returning to the same state. This model gives that idea a precise mathematical form. A trajectory is a history gamma through state or configuration space. When the state carries internal orientation, phase, frame or gauge information, transport around a closed loop can accumulate a nontrivial transformation: the base point returns while the internal state changes. In differential geometry this is holonomy; in quantum mechanics geometric phase is a related phenomenon; in gauge theory Wilson loops encode transport around closed curves. The model therefore distinguishes geometric closure gamma(0)=gamma(T) from full-state recurrence, which requires both base coordinates and internal/fiber state to return. It also adds homotopy, braid and persistent-topology comparators for cases where path class matters. This gives Return-not-Reset a rigorous history-dependent architecture without treating spiritual recurrence as a gauge field or quantum phase.
research_question: When a system completes an apparent cycle, which internal variables or invariants depend on the path taken, and can that path dependence be quantified by holonomy, geometric phase, braid class or another explicit history functional?

trajectory.action: S[gamma]=integral_0^T L(gamma,gamma_dot,t)dt where a variational physical model is defined
trajectory.stationarity: delta S=0 gives classical equations under stated boundary conditions
trajectory.boundary: The path integral is a quantum formalism for amplitudes; it does not mean every narrative or imagined life-path physically occurs.

fiber_and_connection.bundle: pi:E->M with base state x in M and internal/fiber state v in E_x
fiber_and_connection.connection: A specifies how v is transported along gamma
fiber_and_connection.parallel_transport: D v/dt=0 under the chosen connection
fiber_and_connection.return_condition: Full reset requires gamma(T)=gamma(0) AND Hol_gamma v(0)=v(0); base return alone is insufficient.
fiber_and_connection.project_value: This is the strongest mathematical form of Return != Reset found in the project.

abelian_geometric_phase.curvature: F=grad x A in simple Abelian notation, or F=dA geometrically
abelian_geometric_phase.meaning: A cyclic change of parameters can return the Hamiltonian/control parameters to their initial values while a state acquires a geometric phase.
abelian_geometric_phase.boundary: This is a real quantum-mechanical comparator, not evidence that ordinary psychological repetition accumulates Berry phase.

wilson_loop_and_nonabelian_holonomy.meaning: The loop probes accumulated gauge connection around C; nontrivial holonomy can persist even when the base path closes.
wilson_loop_and_nonabelian_holonomy.use_rule: Only use this physically after specifying gauge group, representation, connection and observable.

homotopy_and_path_classes.equivalence: gamma_1~gamma_2 if one can be continuously deformed into the other while respecting required endpoints/constraints
homotopy_and_path_classes.fundamental_group: pi_1(M,x_0) organizes homotopy classes of loops based at x_0
homotopy_and_path_classes.meaning: Two paths with the same start/end can belong to different global path classes when the state space has holes or excluded regions.
homotopy_and_path_classes.test: If an outcome is claimed to depend on path class, show invariance within a class and a reproducible difference across classes.

braid_and_exchange_branch.configuration_space: For multiple distinguishable/indistinguishable objects, configuration-space topology can make exchanges into nontrivial paths.
braid_and_exchange_branch.braid_group: In two-dimensional settings, braid classes can encode exchange histories more richly than ordinary permutations.
braid_and_exchange_branch.project_neighbor: Useful for 'crossing paths' and history-dependent relation structure only when an actual configuration-space problem exists.
braid_and_exchange_branch.boundary: Social interaction histories are not anyons unless a mathematically equivalent braid/configuration model is explicitly defined.

return_map_with_holonomy.fixed_point: A true periodic full state requires P(x*)=x* and H_* v*=v*.
return_map_with_holonomy.meaning: A system can look periodic in coarse coordinates while accumulating internal change cycle after cycle.

curvature_as_path_dependence.small_loop: Hol_gamma approximately I + F(area)+... for sufficiently small loops under standard smoothness assumptions
curvature_as_path_dependence.interpretation: Curvature measures infinitesimal failure of parallel transport to commute around loops.
curvature_as_path_dependence.project_value: If different orderings of local transitions produce different final states, noncommutativity/curvature is a sharper question than calling the process merely spiral-like.

persistent_topology.question: Which loops/holes/features persist across scale rather than appearing because of one arbitrary threshold?
persistent_topology.use: Appropriate for trajectory clouds or reconstructed state-space data when topology is inferred empirically.
persistent_topology.warning: Persistent homology summarizes sampled geometry; it does not by itself reveal the physical causal mechanism.

observable_program: Define the full state, including any internal phase/orientation/memory variables.
Identify repeated/closed trajectories in the observable base space.
Measure whether an internal state variable changes systematically after one loop.
Compare path-dependent models against a Markov/state-only baseline.
Where topology is inferred from data, test robustness to sampling density, noise and filtration scale.
failure_conditions: The supposed history effect disappears once hidden state variables are included in an ordinary Markov model.
A claimed loop/topological class is unstable to small perturbations or sampling choices.
Holonomy language is used without a defined bundle/connection or equivalent transport law.
Path-dependent predictions do not outperform state-only baselines.
Quantum/gauge analogies are presented as empirical project physics without the corresponding physical system.
